title: I Left the Sticky Note on the Shared Printer That Always Jammed for Me

parts.text: I sent a twelve-page close to the shared printer at 4:58 p.m. and it jammed on page one, as it had every Friday I was on deadline. I was twenty-seven, AP clerk, hands gray with toner. Dana from marketing printed a color poster two minutes later with no jam. I opened the tray. My job was paused. Hers was set to override. I set the printer back to first-in and left a sticky: OVERRIDE IS NOT A PERSONALITY. Dana laughed, then found her poster in the queue behind two invoices. She printed after 5. The close went out at 5:02. The sticky stayed until facilities made it a laminated sign, which is the highest honor a sticky can receive. I washed my hands. Gray went down the sink. Fridays still exist. The jam does not, at least not only for me.

social.video_title: The printer had a favorite, and it wasn't the deadline — Part 1/1
social.description: Friday close, toner fingers, marketing override. A sticky became policy. Have you ever had a machine that only jammed for you?
